dmp.description:
The climate crisis and population growth are intensifying pressure on the food system. In this regard, while aquaculture urgently is requiring new feed alternatives, agricultural byproducts such as white grape pomace (WGP) remain underutilized despite their potential for application. An innovative biorefinery has been designed to maximize the potential of WGP with the aim of producing functional and safe ingredients for feed applications: Through the extraction of fermentable sugars Auxenochlorella protothecoides biomass was obtained which was then fractionate by cell disruption methods. The remaining hydrothermally treated WGP polyphenols were extracted using an ethanolic solution and the exhausted pomace underwent solid state fermentation by filamentous fungi to obtain a protein-rich product. This proposal focuses not only on the evaluation of the ingredient’s toxicity, but also in the identification of novel properties as mean to validate the functionality and safety as sustainable feed additives in aquaculture, contributing to a circular bioeconomy.

This DMP would deal with all the data created in the previosly described project. The main data collected would be related to the bioactivities (functionalities) tested and to the characterization of those extracts by LC-MS.
